binding_interpretation: The frozen selection, raw/ADP overlap checks and audited detector arithmetic pass; no integrity defect blocks reporting this pilot.
Six main targets have subarcsecond positional corroboration in the incomplete parent catalog. Fourteen lack coverage there; no external absolute-identity conclusion is supplied for those targets.
The ten main hits are threshold events, not identified lasers or calibrated statistically significant candidates.

Recovery is limited: all six missed strongest injections produce three-pixel runs excluded by the four-pixel requirement. Candidate flux increases the same local scatter used by the detector. General sensitivity or completeness claims are unsupported.
Numerical main audit covers five complete searches plus every reported preliminary-hit window; it is not an independent complete scan of all 100 spectra.
The standalone production review script was frozen after RUN_SUMMARY existed, but its exact five row indices were agreed with the parent before this reviewer viewed main results or flux.
